profile.description:
ABOUT ME
I am Eddy Lucandy Zacarias Serafim Alexandre, born in Cuba and with Angolan nationality. I am a computer engineer with a solid technical background and a great motivation to apply my knowledge in challenging projects. I am characterized by my willingness to continue learning continuously and acquire valuable work experience.
Throughout my professional career, I have participated in various projects, working both as a developer and in roles related to marketing, which has allowed me to develop multidisciplinary skills.
My motto,"Living and Learning", reflects my commitment to personal and professional growth, taking advantage of every experience, big or small, as an opportunity to improve and add value.

project.project1-title: Visualization and Practical Programming of EPROM Memory 27C64
project.project1-description: The project uses software such as Proteus for simulation and HxD for hexadecimal programming. In the practical example, the memory was programmed to display the name "EDDY" on the display, demonstrating the ability to store and reproduce information accurately, demonstrating a practical exercise to understand the fundamentals of memory programming and its application in electronic systems basics.
project.project2-description:
This project consisted of the development of an autonomous mobile platform controlled by ROS (Robot Operating System).

The solution integrates hardware and software to offer intelligent navigation and obstacle detection.
project.project3-description:
A project seeks to provide an innovative solution to the challenge that Alzheimer's represents. We have designed an advanced telecare system that facilitates monitoring, care, and communication between patients, caregivers, and doctors.

The system includes integrated sensors to guarantee the safety of the patient in their home, allowing anomalies such as gas leaks, sudden changes in temperature, or departures at unusual times to be detected. It also has an SOS button for emergencies. The information collected is organized into intuitive tables and graphs, helping doctors and caregivers make informed decisions.
project.project4-description:
This project is based on the creation of an analytical tool for Mister Fantasy users. Our application is designed to assist users in the strategic selection of players for their teams, optimizing performance according to three fundamental variables: predicted points, price, and position on the field.

Through advanced data analysis techniques and predictive algorithms, the system will evaluate historical and current player statistics.
project.project6-description:
Game4Hope is an innovative web platform designed to support people ages 8 and up who face emotional challenges, such as depression and anxiety, through the strategic use of video games.

This project combines therapy, entertainment, and education, offering a safe, welcoming space that encourages mental and emotional well-being.
project.project5-description:
RoadMate is an innovative mobile application developed for students of the European University of Madrid with the aim of optimizing their trips to campus. The tool is designed to reduce transportation costs and travel times, while encouraging interaction and collaboration between members of the university community.

Through the Design Thinking approach, we focus on optimizing both the user experience (UX) and the visual and interactive design (UI) of the application. RoadMate allows students to share rides with peers, offering an affordable, comfortable and efficient alternative to conventional transportation. In addition, the application includes functionalities such as the publication of travel announcements, messaging between users and options to customize transportation preferences.

hobbies.hobbies1-descripcion: I'm passionate about video games both for their entertainment value and for the strategic and creative challenges they present. I enjoy exploring different game mechanics, immersive stories, and cooperating in multiplayer environments, which also strengthens my problem-solving and teamwork skills.
hobbies.hobbies2-descripcion: I'm a film and series enthusiast, finding them to be an excellent way to understand different cultures, narratives, and visual styles. I enjoy analyzing scripts, directing, and developing characters, especially in genres like science fiction, drama, and thrillers.
hobbies.hobbies3-descripcion: I play sports in my free time, primarily soccer, basketball, and volleyball. These activities not only help me stay active but also strengthen skills like teamwork, communication, and discipline.
hobbies.hobbies4-descripcion: Listening to music is an essential part of my daily life. I'm interested in a variety of genres and often use music as a source of inspiration, focus, or relaxation. I especially appreciate how music can influence mood and creativity.
hobbies.hobbies5-descripcion: Cooking is one of my favorite ways to express myself and unwind. I enjoy experimenting with new recipes, exploring the flavors of different cultures, and sharing moments with others through food.
